summary: Veralto Corp filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for an SEC-registered offering of senior notes. The filing discloses terms of the debt issuance, including interest rate, maturity, redemption provisions, and change-of-control repurchase at 101% of principal. The notes are unsecured unsubordinated obligations. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
